days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 135 ? you went 10/8/8 at RPE 7/8/9 last week. Set 1 was exactly what we want: 10 reps at RPE 7. Sets 2 and 3 faded ? 8 reps and RPE climbed to 8 and 9. You are not consistent across all three sets yet, and that's what's keeping you here. Touch the chest, pause, drive through the heels, stay braced the whole set. Take the full 90 seconds of rest ? that's why sets 2 and 3 are slipping. Need 8/8/8 at RPE 7 across all three, or 10/10/10, to earn 140.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 45 ? you went 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/9 last week. Reps stayed in range but RPE was 8 or higher across the board and set 3 crept to 9. That is not a clean performance at 45. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45 degrees off the torso, control the negative. You need all three sets to hit 10 reps at RPE 7 or under to earn 50. The path there starts with locking in your setup before you press, not adjusting mid-set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? you went 10/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. Set 1 got you to the top of the range but RPE was already 8, and sets 2 and 3 dropped back to 8 reps. The reps are inconsistent and the effort cost is too high. Press straight up, full lockout at the top, no lean back. Rest the full 90 seconds between sets. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 or under to earn 35.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Staying at 15 ? you went 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. In range, but short of the top of the range (12 reps) and all three sets at RPE 8. Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbow, 2-second hold at the top, slow the negative ? if you are swinging the weight up, drop the ego and control it. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 or under to earn 20.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: UP to 45 ? you went 10/12/12 at RPE 7/7/7 last week. Sets 2 and 3 hit the top of the range at RPE 7, set 1 was still in range at RPE 7. That is a clean enough baseline to earn the bump. Rope attachment, elbows pinned to your sides, split the rope at the bottom, full extension on every rep. The standard stays the same at 45: need 10-12 at RPE 7 across all three sets. Don't rush it ? this is still a form exercise, not a max effort.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out dips this week. Your bodyweight dip baseline last week was rough: 6/5/3 at RPE 9/9/9. That tells us you are not ready to progress dips yet ? we will come back to them. Close-grip bench press fills the tricep compound slot this week and gives us a loaded baseline. Hands shoulder-width apart, elbows tucked to your sides, lower to the chest, press to full lockout. Start at 95 lbs ? this should be a working weight, not a max. Aim for 8-10 reps at RPE 7 across all three sets. Log everything.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 195 ? pull day was not logged last week. Again. 195 is still your working weight and it is not moving until you show up and log it. Last confirmed session was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Lats tight from the floor, bar dragging up the shins, breathing reset between every rep. Need 8/8/8 at RPE 7 or under, or 10/10/10, to earn 205. You have been sitting on this weight for weeks. Log it.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? pull day was not logged last week. This is now four weeks with no confirmed data on this movement. The prescription is 55. Load 55. Pull to the hip, full second squeeze at the top, slow the negative. Strap up if grip is the issue ? that is not a valid excuse to skip the log. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 60.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Staying at 110 ? pull day was not logged last week. Last confirmed was 10/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom. Stay upright ? do not row it down. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 or under to earn 120. Log it.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Staying at 70 ? pull day was not logged last week. The prescription is 70 and it has been 70 since you jumped to 75 without authorization and paid for it with 12/12/12 at RPE 9/9/9. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high, external rotation at the end of every rep. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 or under to earn 75. Log all three sets.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? pull day was not logged last week. The first baseline at 55 lbs is still pending after two weeks. Strict form, elbows pinned to your sides, no swinging, full curl to shoulder height, slow controlled negative. Aim for 8-10 at RPE 7. Log all three sets ? this is exactly the kind of movement that stalls your arm development when it gets skipped.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out dumbbell reverse flye this week. You had a clean confirmed session on reverse flye (12/12/12 at RPE 7/7/7 at 15 lbs) a few weeks back and we will revisit it. Hammer curl fills the bicep isolation slot this week and targets the brachialis for overall arm thickness. Neutral grip, elbows pinned, no swinging, full curl and controlled negative. Start at 30 lbs. Aim for 8-10 reps at RPE 7 across all three sets. Log everything.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 165 ? leg day was not logged last week. 165 is your working weight and it is not moving until you log it. Last confirmed session was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8, two sessions in a row with the same result. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175. Log it this time.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 155 ? leg day was not logged last week. Last confirmed was the session that earned you this bump: 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7 at 145. You earned 155 ? now you have to show up and lift it. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar tracks close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom. Do not round the lower back. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to keep moving.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? leg day was not logged last week. Last confirmed was 10/10/10 at RPE 7/8/8. You have two reps left in the tank ? stop putting the dumbbells down early. Rear foot on the bench, drop straight down, front shin stays vertical, drive through the front heel. Log each side separately. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 or under to earn 35.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Staying at 75 ? leg day was not logged last week. Last confirmed was 12/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8. Set 1 hit the top of the range but sets 2 and 3 dropped and all three sets were at RPE 8. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension at the top, hard squeeze for one full second. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 8 or under to earn 85.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? leg day was not logged last week. Last confirmed was 12/15/12 at RPE 7/8/8. Set 2 was strong but sets 1 and 3 landed at the bottom of the range and RPE was inconsistent. Curl the heels toward the glutes, full ROM, controlled on the way back down. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 or under to earn 60.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.notes: Staying ? leg day was not logged last week so we have no baseline yet. This was rotated in last week as the next step up from Captain's Chair Knee Raise. Hang from the pull-up bar on the rack, raise your knees to chest height, control the descent all the way down ? no swinging, no dropping. First confirmed baseline still pending. Aim for 10-12 reps at RPE 7-8. Log all three sets.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
